BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. (BMRN) reported its first-quarter 2025 results in a release covering the period from March 31 to April 1, 2025. The company posted total revenues of $745 million, up 15% year over year, with the growth largely driven by VOXZOGO, which saw a 40% year-over-year increase in revenue as new patients initiated therapy across all regions. This indicates broadening uptake of VOXZOGO during the quarter.

On the earnings side, GAAP net income rose 109% to $186 million, while non-GAAP income increased by 58% to $221 million. The substantial gains in both GAAP and non-GAAP profitability metrics suggest improved operating performance alongside the top-line growth.
